title: Congtie Biomarker and Measurement Registry Concept Schema v0.1
description: Draft / Founder Review Pending. Public canonical Registry concept schema only. No active records, personal observations, user identifiers, consent records, longitudinal events, personal targets, database behavior, API behavior, or runtime authorization are created by this schema.

unit_code.description: UCUM or reviewed local unit code. Null is allowed only when status is pending or not_applicable.

UnitDefinition.description: A unit representation. UCUM belongs here rather than in measurement-concept external code mappings.

code.description: Required for mapped or deprecated_mapping; may be null for pending or no_match.

ExternalCodeMapping.description: A reviewed concept- or profile-scoped code mapping. UCUM is excluded because unit codes are governed by UnitDefinition. mapping_key must not be duplicated across concept and profile scopes within one RegistryConcept.

DeviceMetricMapping.description: Profile-specific vendor/device/algorithm mapping. It is authoritative only inside MeasurementProfile.device_mappings and all source keys resolve to the parent RegistryConcept source pool.

interval_representation.description: Reviewed interval rule when simple numeric lower/upper bounds are insufficient.

ReferenceContext.description: Public, method- and population-scoped reference metadata. laboratory_reported_reference_interval_definition describes public lab/method metadata only; a user's original report interval belongs to the Observation layer.

source_reference_keys.description: Reviewed biological or product-governance source keys resolving to RegistryConcept.source_references.

source_references.description: Central source pool for this concept. source_key values must be unique and all key references must resolve to this array; programmatic validation enforces both rules.

RegistryConcept.description: One public canonical measurement concept. source_references is the single source metadata pool; every *_source_keys value must resolve within that pool, source_key values must be unique, external mapping_key values must not be duplicated across concept/profile scopes, and device mappings are profile-only. These cross-object constraints require programmatic validation in addition to JSON Schema. Namespace and information_type compatibility is enforced by both this schema and the permanent authoring validator.

UnitPolicy.description: Concept-level unit governance. single_canonical requires a reviewed canonical UCUM or local unit; profile_specific and non_convertible representations keep units at profile level.

DerivedComputation.description: Traceable derived computation with one canonical inputs list. Inputs may be Registry concepts, user-context parameters, constants, or categorical parameters; input_key uniqueness and candidate resolution are enforced by the permanent authoring validator.

ComputationInput.description: A formula input definition, never a user's actual value. User context such as age_years or sex_at_birth is represented as input metadata and does not create a BM/ME Registry concept.

x-schema-id-note: The $id is a stable schema identifier only. It does not assert that the URL currently serves this file and does not authorize website publication or runtime serving.
